_about: Hand decisions for scripts/fetch_grants.py: which NIH RePORTER PI profiles (nih), NSF lead-PI ids (nsf_pi),
NSF co-PI emails (nsf_co) and single NSF awards (nsf_awards) belong to each QCB faculty member.
first and last add name spellings to search under. check marks a person to look at again.
nih_skip lists NIH core projects to leave out: someone else's grants that RePORTER files under a kept profile.
Everything the searches find that isn't listed here was rejected as a namesake on the reviewed date,
except NSF identities carrying the person's faculty.json email, which are kept automatically.

helen-berman.note: All NIH grants are from Rutgers (PDB, FY1985–2015, many P41 subprojects); none at USC. NSF: all at Rutgers and earlier, before USC. Two awards now show Stephen Burley or Brinda Vallat as PI after she retired from Rutgers, but keep her piId.

peter-calabrese.note: NSF: one 2001 individual postdoctoral fellowship (the awardee is listed as himself).

liang-chen.note: Kept Liang Chen at USC; LIANGJING Chen and QiLiang Chen are other people (RePORTER matches first names loosely). NSF: the only Liang Chen lead PI is at Nebraska, a namesake.

tsu-pei-chiu.note: No NIH, NSF, OpenAlex or ORCID grants found.

geoffrey-fudenberg.note: No active grant found: his NIGMS R35 (R35GM143116) ended 2026-05-31 and RePORTER lists nothing newer. A renewal may not be listed yet.

steve-kay.note: One 2012 Scripps NSF award moved to a new PI and id; kept by hand from OpenAlex.

andrew-smith.note: 14 NIH profiles named Andrew Smith; kept Andrew David Smith at USC. All NSF Andrew Smiths are other people. NSF: seven Andrew Smiths, none at USC or with his email.

andrew-mcmahon.note: No active grant found: his last USC R01 (R01DK126925) ended 2026-05-31 and RePORTER lists nothing newer. A renewal or new grant may not be listed yet.

simon-tavare.note: NSF: piId 270032712 is his 2020 Columbia award (same person, new id when he moved); 'Tavaré' with the accent returns nothing, so the search uses 'Tavare'.

michael-waterman.note: Michael R Waterman (Vanderbilt, biochemistry) is a namesake.

don-b-arnold.note: Donald Hayes Arnold (Vanderbilt) is a namesake.

charleston-chiang.note: NSF: the USC rows under 'Chiang' are Cindy Chiang (linguistics) and others; none are his.

rosa-di-felice.note: No NIH, NSF, OpenAlex or ORCID grants found (NSF search tried 'Di Felice', 'DiFelice' and 'Felice'). NSF: 'Di Felice' returns nothing and 'Felice' returns 32 awards, none hers.

peter-foster.note: No NIH, NSF, OpenAlex or ORCID grants found; NSF's USC Fosters are Ian Foster on ISI awards.

scott-fraser.note: Two tiny 1990s duplicate NIH profiles are the same person; kept all three. NSF: emails on 1980s UC Irvine awards show his current USC address, so the match is safe. A Fraser at Monterey Peninsula College is a namesake.

krishna-garikipati.note: NSF lists him as Krishnakumar, so a 'Krishna Garikipati' search finds nothing; the script searches by surname.

eva-kanso.note: NIH grant is multi-PI with the University of Iowa. NSF gave her two lead-PI ids; both carry kanso@usc.edu.

judith-kribelbauer.note: NIH lists her as Judith Kribelbauer-Swietek.

jerry-s-h-lee.note: No grants found: the NIH Jerry Lees are Loma Linda and other namesakes, and NSF, OpenAlex and ORCID have none.

sheng-li.note: 15 NIH profiles named Sheng Li; kept the Jackson Lab → USC one (epigenomics). 7845608 (UTHealth Houston, rehabilitation) and the rest are other people. NSF: the Sheng Li at Virginia and Sheng-San Li (Florida) are namesakes; no NSF awards for him.

yan-liu.note: No NIH grants. RePORTER's loose first-name match returns Zhaoyang Liu (USC), who is someone else. NSF: the ASU and Illinois Yan Lius are namesakes.

paul-newton.note: Paul A Newton (UC Berkeley, 1986–87 NIH) is a namesake.

julia-schwartzman.note: One 2017 NIH fellowship at Mass Eye and Ear, before USC.

chang-shu.note: Kept Chang Shu at USC Preventive Medicine (autism, R01MH143902).

rory-spence.note: No NIH, NSF, OpenAlex or ORCID grants found.

paul-thomas.note: 8 NIH profiles; kept Paul D. Thomas (PANTHER, USC).

paul-thompson.note: 9 NIH profiles; kept Paul M. Thompson (UCLA → USC, ENIGMA). Many grants are center subprojects. P20RR017698 (2008–11, University of South Carolina, peptide-based borono-lectins) is Paul R. Thompson, a chemist, filed under the same RePORTER profile, so it's left out. NSF: kept only Paul M Thompson (thompson@ini.usc.edu); Paul B Thompson (Michigan State), Dartmouth and Florida Paul Thompsons are namesakes.

arthur-toga.note: Kept Arthur W. Toga (UCLA → USC). 81 of his NIH records are center subprojects, collapsed into their parent grants.

arieh-warshel.note: NSF: the older id 000159775 (USC 1983–85) has no email but is the same USC chemistry PI.
